newspaper.quote: Additional materials: glossy ads, phone books (remove plastic bags and non-paper inserts), magazines, newspapers, coupons, coffee cups, paper bags

magazines-catalogs.quote: Additional materials: glossy ads, phone books (remove plastic bags and non-paper inserts), magazines, newspapers, coupons, coffee cups, paper bags

junk-mail.quote: Mail: greeting cards, postcards, letters, envelopes, stationery, brochures, direct mail

office-paper.quote: Office supplies: index cards, file folders, office paper

cardboard-box.quote: Shipping and delivery boxes (flatten and cut to no larger than 2 ft x 2 ft)

pizza-box-greasy.quote: Non-greasy pizza boxes (recycle the clean part and discard the greasy or soiled portion)
pizza-box-greasy.note: The clean lid can be recycled; the greasy part cannot.

paper-cup-hot.quote: Additional materials: glossy ads, phone books (remove plastic bags and non-paper inserts), magazines, newspapers, coupons, coffee cups, paper bags

paper-plates-napkins.quote: Paper towels and napkins; Paper plates

paper-bag.quote: Additional materials: glossy ads, phone books (remove plastic bags and non-paper inserts), magazines, newspapers, coupons, coffee cups, paper bags

beverage-carton.quote: Dairy milk, nut milk, and juice cartons (Tetra Pak packaging)

pet-bottle.quote: Bottles for milk, juice, soda, and water

hdpe-jug.quote: Shampoo and conditioner bottles; Detergent and softener containers

plastic-cup-lid.quote: Lids and caps may be attached to bottles and placed in the recycling. Loose lids and caps should be placed in the trash.

bottle-caps.quote: Lids and caps may be attached to bottles and placed in the recycling. Loose lids and caps should be placed in the trash.
bottle-caps.note: Caps screwed onto the bottle are fine.

plastic-bucket.quote: Buckets up to 5 gallons (remove wire handle)

plastic-hard-6.quote: Denver accepts plastic containers labeled #1-6, including bottles, tubs, jugs, jars, and cups.

plastic-toy.quote: Solid Waste does not accept plastic items that are not containers, including:

plastic-bag-film.quote: Plastic bags (grocery and trash bags)– Denver’s #1 contaminant!

chip-bag-wrapper.quote: Wrappers, condiment packets, juice pouches, and chip bags

garden-hose-tangler.quote: Tangling items like garden hoses and Christmas lights

steel-can.quote: Tin and steel cans, like soup, fruit, vegetable, and pet food cans

scrap-metal.note: Pots and pans are also listed as not accepted.
